final.agentMessage:
I found the online renewal eligibility information on this page and will now provide the answer.
DONE: Yes - Many standard California driver's license renewals can be completed online.

Where to start: Start in the Online Renewal area of the official agency site.

Check first from page:
- Your renewal notice says if you are eligible to renew online.
- Have your license number, date of birth, and renewal notice nearby.
- If you need a new photo, test, or REAL ID upgrade, you may be asked to come in.
